captions.detailed: A black follow-focus gear ring mounted around a cylindrical lens barrel. The assembly features a textured outer gear band designed to engage with a focus motor, and a small rectangular clamp block on the side housing a light gray locking screw. The gear band is designed to rotate continuously around the main axis of the lens, while the locking screw tightens inward along a linear path perpendicular to the lens barrel to secure the clamp.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a follow-focus gear ring mounted on a lens barrel. The assembly should feature a cylindrical lens body, a rotating outer gear band, and a side-mounted clamping block with a light gray locking screw that adjusts along a linear axis.
captions.factory: Construct a cylindrical base to represent the lens barrel. Create the focus gear ring by patterning teeth radially around a thin ring, and mount it to the barrel using a continuous revolute joint. Model a rectangular clamp block on the side of the ring, and insert a small cylinder with a hexagonal head to represent the locking screw, connecting it via a prismatic joint that moves perpendicular to the lens axis.
